import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x = int(data[0])
    # post-increment
    a = x
    x += 1
    # pre-increment
    x += 1
    b = x
    # output
    out = f"{a}\n{b}\n{x}"
    sys.stdout.write(out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
